podcast.body: This collaboration CD with rapper Jay-Z was released in 2004. It was one of the many creative ventures pursued by band members during the group's extended hiatus between *Meteora* and *Minutes to Midnight*. "And then there was that collision course collaboration CD with Jay-Z."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.body: This mashup album was a collaboration between Linkin Park and rapper Jay-Z, undertaken during a period when the band members were pursuing other projects to restore their creative juices after intense touring. "to do something like a mashup album with Jay-Z called Collision Course."
